scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@theme-editor/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@theme-editor/api
scripts.dev:api:stable: npm run build --workspace=@theme-editor/shared && npm run start:stable --workspace=@theme-editor/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@theme-editor/shared && npm run build --workspace=@theme-editor/db && npm run typecheck --workspace=mvp && npm run typecheck --workspace=@theme-editor/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@theme-editor/api
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:cross-phase: npm run build --workspace=@theme-editor/shared && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/cross-phase-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:cross-phase
scripts.test:phase-0-4: npm run test:all && npm run test:perf && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:phase-0-6: npm run test:phase-0-4 && dotenv -e .env -- vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/uj-03-preview-journey.test.ts
scripts.test:phase-0-7: npm run test:phase-0-6 && dotenv -e .env -- vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/uj-04-preview-editor.test.ts
scripts.test:phase-0-8: npm run test:phase-0-7 && dotenv -e .env -- vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/uj-05-chat-refinement.test.ts
scripts.test:phase-0-9: npm run test:phase-0-8 && dotenv -e .env -- vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/uj-06-apply-journey.test.ts tests/integration/uj-07-rollback-journey.test.ts
scripts.test:phase-0-9:auto: npm run test:phase-0-9 && npm run lint && npm run build --workspace=mvp
scripts.test:phase-0-10: npm run test:phase-0-9 && dotenv -e .env -- vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/uj-08-production-readiness.test.ts && dotenv -e .env -- vitest run --config vitest.perf.config.ts tests/perf/phase-10-concurrent-pipeline.test.ts

scripts.test:phase-0-4:full: npm run test:phase-0-4 && npm run test:phase-0-4:live
scripts.db:migrate:status: dotenv -e .env -- npx prisma migrate status --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate
